name: Osoppo (Italy)
description: Vertical tricolour of green, white and red, the green charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Osoppo (a chevron on blue above a mountain) within branches.
history: The flag was recognised by decree of the Prime Minister on 1 February 1949.

features.role: Osoppo arms — chevron on blue above a mountain, crowned, within branches
